sourceName: Mundus country boundary view (Natural Earth Admin 0)
version: Natural Earth 5.1.2, Mundus boundary view; high-detail anchors cross-checked against low-detail geometry
transformations: Compute interior label anchors and sampled boundary clearance from the high-detail Mundus country polygons
Retain only anchors contained by both high- and low-detail geometries when both are present
Round coordinates and clearance to six decimal places for deterministic static delivery
missingValuePolicy: Countries without a cross-detail anchor use the runtime low-detail geometry algorithm or an explicit verified fallback.
boundaryPolicy: Mundus draws boundaries from the Natural Earth China point of view, except that Taiwan is shown as its own unit. Boundaries are a cartographic view and are not a legal authority on territorial status.
